description: This file defines a class 'ExtractionPipeline' that performs entity and relationship extraction from text, along with embedding generation and Neo4j graph database interactions. It includes methods for extracting entities and relationships, generating embeddings for entities, and upserting data into Neo4j.

classes.name: ExtractionPipeline
classes.description: A class providing a deterministic text extraction pipeline with optional language model support for entities and relationships, integrated with a Neo4j graph database.

methods.name: __init__(self, embedder: EmbeddingProvider, graph: Neo4jClient)
methods.description: Initializes the extraction pipeline with an embedder and a Neo4j client.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Dict[str,Any]],List[Dict[str,Any]]] extract(self, text: str)
methods.description: Extracts entities and relationships from input text using regex heuristics, limited to first 50 sentences.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] embed_entities(self, entities: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Generates embeddings for a list of entities using the embedder.

methods.name: None upsert_to_graph( self, entities: List[Dict[str, Any]], relationships: List[Dict[str, Any]], embeddings: List[Dict[str, Any]], )
methods.description: Upserts entities, relationships, and embeddings into the Neo4j graph database.
